LanguageData.LP_UH_GhoulBody.label: ghoul body
LanguageData.LP_UH_GhoulBody.description: Corpse-eating undead: doesn't eat or sleep, never breaks, doesn't mind cold, immune to necrotic damage. Targets hit by its claws make a Constitution save or are fully paralyzed for 3 seconds. Radiant and fire damage ×1.5.
LanguageData.LP_UH_WightBody.label: wight body
LanguageData.LP_UH_WightBody.description: An undead warrior that retains its martial skill: doesn't eat or sleep, never breaks, immune to necrotic damage, armor +15%. Each weapon hit drains 30% of the damage to heal itself. Radiant and fire damage ×1.5.
LanguageData.LP_UH_WraithBody.label: wraith body
LanguageData.LP_UH_WraithBody.description: A semi-corporeal wandering soul: doesn't eat or sleep, never breaks, immune to necrotic damage, damage from blades, guns and arrows halved (radiant, fire, silver and magic work normally), movement ×1.3. The living within 2 cells lose 3 health every 2 seconds, and what it drains heals itself.
LanguageData.LP_UH_VampireBody.label: vampire body
LanguageData.LP_UH_VampireBody.description: Blood-drinking undead aristocrats: don't eat or sleep, never break, immune to necrotic damage. Heal 4 injury every 250 ticks, but stop if hit by radiant or fire damage within 10 seconds; weapon hits drain 50% of the damage to heal themselves. Standing outdoors by day they take ×1.5 damage and stop healing. Radiant and fire damage ×1.5.
LanguageData.LP_UH_Paralysis.label: corpse venom paralysis
LanguageData.LP_UH_Paralysis.description: A ghoul's corpse venom: fully paralyzed, able to move again after 3 seconds.
